items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I did 26 weeks with Julie Andrews, her show

ctx.x: We had been recording together in New York off and on. Riverside, we did an album, and we had known each other a long time. So we started corresponding about getting together, you know, and he was busy and I was busy, too, but I was doing good, you know, making records, and I had this -- I did 26 weeks with Julie Andrews, her show, and I was really busy doing a lot of things and I got this assignment to do all the trumpet work in "Lady Sings the Blues."
